title: Choose the visual world
question: The roll assigned The 80-Column Record. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: The 80-Column Record
options.thesis: Every payload is a card: fixed columns, punched data, one machine-readable record.
options.viewport: Fields on manila, the encoded string as a column-numbered card, the symbol on an ivory plate with its measurements in the margin.
options.risk: Retro-computing costume if the card decorates instead of carrying the payload's own column structure.

raised.raise: Line-emphasis: the selected content type is the only saturated element on the sheet; everything else sits in ink.
Single-size discipline: no second type size carries rank; weight, case and hairlines do.
Margin numerics: module count, EC level, contrast and scale sit as tabular figures in a labelled margin, never floating.
Hard halves: one continuous printed rule divides fields from result; no floating cards, no shadows.

options.label: The Intaglio Note
options.thesis: The export is a note: engraved frame, serial in the margin, the symbol as the portrait.
options.viewport: A note-shaped sheet divided by an engraved frame: fields at left, the symbol centred inside its engraved border, serial line beneath.
options.risk: The direction most runs in this category land on, and ornament near the quiet zone can cost a scan.

options.label: The Bitmap Specimen
options.thesis: The symbol is a bitmap, and the tool is honest about every pixel of it.
options.viewport: The symbol at 1:1 with its module grid exposed, an integer scale ladder beneath it, display type set at whole-pixel multiples.
options.risk: Holds the product's pixel truth and loses audience identification; can read as a type-specimen exercise.
options.case: Fuses cleanly: module scale is an integer multiple, so the world's whole-pixel rule is the product's own rule. Loses on audience identification, not on clarity.

options.label: The Reference Setting
options.lineage: wide-margin reference editions with a centre key rail
options.thesis: A reference edition at work: fields in one column, the parameter rail between them and the plate, states printed as marks.
options.viewport: Two columns twinned around a narrow vermilion key rail, the symbol held in a measured block at right, apparatus in the wide margin.
options.risk: The most disciplined option and the least warm; a working tool that reads like a printed page needs strict component discipline or it goes stiff.
options.case: Fuses cleanly: the parameter rail is a real editor topology, and printed-mark states map to focus, selected and disabled. Narrowly behind on product clarity because field entry is not a page.

options.label: The Midnight Diagram
options.thesis: Content types as lines, their field chains as stations, the chosen route burning bright.
options.viewport: A midnight-blue sheet where fourteen content types run as coloured lines into one interchange.
options.risk: Bends the payload into a route map the user never asked to read.
options.case: Fuses poorly: fourteen templates are not a network, and the metaphor obscures what is being encoded.
options.kept: Emphasis by saturation: one active route in colour, everything else in ink.

options.label: The Slide Rack
options.lineage: 1971 pocket airline timetables on a light table
options.thesis: One size of type, rank carried by weight and reversal, containers raked on a goldenrod bed.
options.viewport: A raked rack of tinted panes over a lit bed, every column set at one size.
options.risk: Raking and reversal fight a form that must be typed into.
options.case: Fuses poorly: the rack is a reading surface, not an editor.
options.kept: Single-size discipline: rank from weight, case and rule, never from another type size.

options.label: The J-Card
options.thesis: Two hard halves, side A and side B, ruled in ballpoint and timed to the second.
options.viewport: A folded inlay laid flat, fields down one half, the symbol on the other, running times hard against the margin.
options.risk: Handwriting in a tool whose whole promise is exactness.
options.case: Fuses poorly: the warmth is real, the precision is not.
options.kept: Hard halves: one unbroken rule splits the sheet, never a floating card.

options.label: The Data Field
options.thesis: Pure black and white bar-fields with tabular numerics packing the margin.
options.viewport: A wall of hairline vertical bars with dense labelled numbers to the edge.
options.risk: Its signature move is a full-frame inversion, and this product may never invert the symbol.
options.case: Fuses badly on truth: the world's one memorable gesture contradicts the quiet-zone and no-invert commitments.
options.kept: Margin numerics: measurements as labelled tabular figures, never floating chips.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: What this category ships, executed impeccably.
canonCard.viewport: The form-left, symbol-right arrangement every competitor already ships.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from the competition by design.
